quest.5130110CBEF3D218.quest_desc: Railcraft Blast Furnace: 34 blocks, external dimensions 3×4×3. Leave the interior hollow; this is a different construction from its Immersive Engineering counterpart.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Railcraft’s Blast Furnace is a 3×3×4 structure with an internal hollow, using 34 Blast Furnace Bricks. Follow the layers in Railcraft’s diagram and do not build another furnace directly against it.
The quest detects formation. Then test a steel recipe with iron and a supported fuel in its interface; merely carrying bricks or building another mod’s furnace does not satisfy this native trigger.
quest.5130110CBEF3D218.title: Steel Mill

quest.5130114354CF7719.quest_desc: The Steel Crowbar is Railcraft’s main tool for tracks and carts. Right-clicking a supported track changes its direction or opens settings; on a locomotive it can reverse the facing.
Use sneak-right-click on each of two carts to link them. Practise on a short test track: normal right-click and sneaking perform different actions.
quest.5130114354CF7719.title: Obtain 1 × Steel Crowbar

quest.5130116FB1CF442C.quest_desc: The Powered Rolling Machine upgrades manual metal forming into machine production. Its SOQM recipe requires a Precision Mechanism; after placement, supply power and ingredients.
Complete one required recipe before connecting input and output pipes. It supports automation, but an incorrect grid remainder or missing ingredient stops production regardless of stored energy.
quest.5130116FB1CF442C.title: Obtain 1 × Powered Rolling Machine

quest.5130118593FC506A.quest_desc: A One-Way Track enforces direction while powered by redstone. It reverses a cart travelling against its arrow; without a signal it behaves like ordinary track.
Set the arrow with the Crowbar and test both directions. The arrow alone is not a permanent barrier: losing power disables direction enforcement.
quest.5130118593FC506A.title: Obtain 1 × One-Way Track Kit
quest.513011863D5B3F64.quest_desc: A Coupler Track automates joining or separating carts. It needs a redstone signal to act; select the intended mode with the tool before sending carts over it.
Test two empty carts and inspect their coupling first. Do not send a loaded train through until you have confirmed that the track couples rather than separates it.
quest.513011863D5B3F64.title: Obtain 1 × Coupler Track Kit

quest.5130118DB31A46A1.quest_desc: Railcraft Coke Oven: 26 blocks, external dimensions 3×3×3. Leave the interior hollow; this is a different construction from its Immersive Engineering counterpart.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.

Railcraft’s Coke Oven is a 3×3×3 cube with a hollow centre, requiring 26 Coke Oven Bricks. Use Railcraft’s own bricks and leave a gap between ovens; the task detects native formation of this structure.
After construction, load coal and collect coke and creosote. Do not copy Immersive Engineering’s solid 27-block layout here: the two mods use different multiblocks.
quest.5130118DB31A46A1.title: Coke Head

quest.513011C793F4D2F0.quest_desc: Minimum Railcraft boiler: one Solid Fueled Firebox with one Low Pressure Steam Boiler Tank directly above it. Supply water and solid fuel to the Firebox.
These tasks verify the two-block kit, not temperature or steam production. A 2×2 or 3×3 base requires additional fireboxes and tanks.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
quest.513011C793F4D2F0.title: Steam Boiler: Minimum Kit

quest.513011CFD1B179B3.quest_desc: A Locking Track holds a cart at a stop while unpowered. A redstone signal releases it; the selected mode decides whether it also receives a boost and in which direction.
Use the Crowbar to cycle holding, boarding and train modes. Test the arrow and mode with one cart: releasing a cart and launching it are different behaviours.
quest.513011CFD1B179B3.title: Obtain 1 × Locking Track Kit
quest.513011D45FA1F900.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Steel Ingot (railcraft:steel_ingot). The items are not consumed by this task.

quest.513011E68E6D4690.quest_desc: The Manual Rolling Machine makes rails and other metal parts through its own recipes. Arrange the required materials in its grid and check the displayed result.
If only enough material for one cycle remains, click the output display to force the craft. For continuous part production, progress to the Powered Rolling Machine with automated input.
quest.513011E68E6D4690.title: Obtain 1 × Manual Rolling Machine

quest.513011F655EF052F.quest_desc: To form a train, place two compatible carts close together on a track and sneak-right-click first one, then the other with a Steel Crowbar. The quest checks actual cart linking.
Test the pair on a short straight section before adding more carts. A coupling is not an engine: the train still needs propulsion and a correctly configured track.
quest.513011F655EF052F.title: Linking Carts
